ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels and 35% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels concentrated at the center and margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-intensity zone at the central peduncle junction; continuous dark banding along the trailing edge; high-frequency dark-pixel mottling across the interior light-intensity lobes; distinct dark linear marking on the lower-medial quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe baselines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire length of the trailing edge, featuring high-amplitude peaks and valleys particularly at the mid-lobe sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory curving outward and upward from the center, terminating in rounded tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of brownish-orange and high-contrast white pixels located at the distal tips of both lobes, indicating localized surface texture disruptions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions detected on the light-colored surface of the left lobe, primarily oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized orange-brown textured masses and scarring present at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with previous epibiont attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent dark diagonal mark on the inner ventral surface of the left lobe, distinct from the surrounding mottling pattern.
